notes: One file for both themes; gorgias-dark.svg goes. DECISION: Gorgias's header logo, favicon and the logo SVG in its own repo are black; only the app icon / social avatar (a PNG) is coral on black, and no coral SVG exists anywhere I looked, so this file is the official black mark recoloured to the brand's coral token (exactly the avatar's colour). If you count the black header/favicon as the mark, the alternative is monochrome-brand (keep the current black/white pair). Coral on the white tile is pale but readable. developers.gorgias.com still shows the retired blue logo (#0075FF) as its apple-touch-icon.
